_readme: The single source of the narration. `text` is sent to the TTS voice with the '|' marks removed; '|' only marks caption breaks. `offset` = seconds after the scene starts that the line begins. Edit here, then run `npm run voiceover`.

voice.direction: Young adult female, Indian English. Conversational, warm, clear, confident. Not an advert read. Natural pauses between sentences.

lines.text: You start earning. | The money is finally yours.
The essentials come first: rent, bills, groceries, travel. | What you do with what's left is what matters.
Should you save it, invest it, | or get insurance first?
Those were my questions too. | In my semester project, I realised I didn't understand money. | Did other young earners feel the same?
I studied the apps people use. | Most assumed you were ready to invest.
I spoke with over forty people, | and had twenty-three focused conversations with early-career professionals, aged twenty-one to twenty-six.
Different habits. | The same need: guidance before action.
Managing what's left isn't just investing. | Spending, saving, emergency funds, insurance — it's all connected.
Most products help you act. | Few help you understand.
With your essentials covered, Stack Up gives you a safe space | to understand, explore and practise managing what's left.
Your first move is mutual funds, | explained simply, one concept at a time.
Then, guided questions: | how you feel about change, and how long you'd stay invested.
A recommendation, with its reasons — | and the freedom to compare before choosing.
Your first investment happens in small, guided steps. | And with every step, your confidence grows.
Every decision fills your Confidence Jar — | until you're ready for real money.
Stack Up. | Understand money. Build confidence. Make informed decisions.
